verdict.rationale: Zep has a first-party 'memory for agent frameworks' docs page that names LangGraph, CrewAI, the Vercel AI SDK and other frameworks. It says these integrations persist conversation turns, search the Context Graph and place retrieved context, which covers the core of the story. Missing for 10: LangChain itself is never explicitly named, there are no per-framework setup or code details in the evidence, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration that the integrations work as documented.
